overview_description.description: Every year, health care associated infections (HAI) kill more people than breast and prostatic cancer combined. According to the WHO, hand hygiene is the single most effective way to reduce HAIs. Making use of technology megatrends of the industry 4.0, such as the Internet of Things, wearables, and artificial intelligence, aidy is able of change the behavior and hand hygiene culture of healthcare workers helping to solve this worldwide problem.

about_short_description.short_description: Preventing health care associated infections by changing the culture of hand hygiene among health care workers using IoT, wearables, and AI.

product.name: Aidy System
product.description: An electronic monitoring system that records and quantifies hand hygiene compliance among healthcare staff to reduce infection risks in healthcare facilities.

product.name: Wearable Tag
product.description: A wearable device that identifies healthcare professionals and provides real-time LED feedback on their hand hygiene compliance.

product.name: Hygiene Sensor
product.description: A sensor that detects when a healthcare worker performs hand hygiene and sends compliance data to the cloud while activating feedback on the wearable tag.

product.name: Proximity Beacon (Faro)
product.description: A device that monitors the proximity between healthcare staff and patient beds or hygiene-required zones, sending data to the cloud for compliance tracking.

product.name: Aidy App and Dashboard
product.description: A cloud-based platform that displays real-time hand hygiene compliance data collected from sensors and wearable devices, accessible from any device.
